targets.rawSql: SELECT relationship_status, count(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY relationship_status ORDER BY relationship_status
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_size), 0) AS total_pipeline_deal_size FROM customers WHERE relationship_status IN ('prospect', 'active')

panels.title: Customers by Status and Assigned Reps

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.company_name, c.relationship_status, c.deal_size, sr.name AS sales_rep, sp.name AS support_rep, c.created_at FROM customers c LEFT JOIN employees sr ON sr.id = c.assigned_sales_rep_id LEFT JOIN employees sp ON sp.id = c.assigned_support_rep_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

panels.title: Realized Revenue (Akaunting, all-time)
panels.description: Reads Akaunting's MariaDB directly (net_dmz) for realized/booked revenue -- the customers table above tracks pipeline/CRM status in narrative-db, this panel is the actual-dollars counterpart from the accounting system.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS realized_revenue FROM ak_transactions WHERE company_id = 1 AND type = 'income' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT paid_at AS time, amount AS revenue FROM ak_transactions WHERE company_id = 1 AND type = 'income' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(paid_at) ORDER BY paid_at
